model.note: Part outlines are traced from Mitsubishi's photo of a current MV Triton GLX club cab chassis with alloy tray and are approximate. Ute 1 may be the earlier MR (23MY) with a different cab or body: check the VIN and the AdBlue cap (blue cap = MV). The engine, filters, AdBlue system, cooling, brakes and driveline are hidden and listed. No part numbers are held: the dealer supplies parts under capped-price servicing, and the schedules come from the MMAL 23MY MR and 24MY MV maintenance schedules (the OM link is the MMAL schedules page).

tray.name: Alloy tray and mudguards
tray.desc: Alloy cab-chassis tray as on the GLX in Mitsubishi's photo. Ute 1's body (tray or tub) and cab style may differ: check the vehicle. The body is inspected at each 12-month / 15,000 km service.

rack.name: Headboard and roof rack
rack.desc: Tray headboard with a rack over the cab roof, as in the photo: check whether Ute 1 has one. The body is inspected at each service.

cab.name: Cab, roof and rear section
cab.desc: Club cab shown in the photo. Body is inspected at every service. Book a dealer service every 12 months (at about 8,349 km Ute 1 always reaches the date first).

windscreen.name: Windscreen and wipers
windscreen.desc: Lights and wipers are checked at every 12-month / 15,000 km service. Pre-start: glass clear, wipers working.

bonnet.name: Bonnet and engine bay
bonnet.desc: Under the bonnet: the 2.4 L turbo diesel (MR 4N15 or MV 4N16). Weekly: engine oil and coolant level. Every 24 months / 30,000 km the dealer checks the drive belt, intake/turbo hoses and radiator hoses.

fender.name: Front guard (left)
fender.desc: Body panel over the front left wheel. Inspected with the body at each service.

door.name: Front door (left)
door.desc: Body, door and lights are inspected at each service. Pre-start: warning lamps and fluid leaks.

mirror.name: Door mirror
mirror.desc: Inspected with the body at each service.

chassis.name: Chassis, suspension and driveline
chassis.desc: Each service: suspension, ball joints, driveshaft boots, steering, and transmission, transfer and diff leaks. Every 24 months / 30,000 km: grease the suspension arms, steering linkage and propeller shaft; check the exhaust, brake hoses, drum brakes and fuel lines.

wheelFL.name: Front wheel and tyre, left
wheelFL.desc: Pre-start: tyre pressure, cuts and tread; check pressures weekly. Tyres are inspected at every 12-month / 15,000 km service; wheel alignment is checked every 24 months / 30,000 km.

wheelFR.name: Front wheel and tyre, right
wheelFR.desc: Pre-start: tyre pressure, cuts and tread; check pressures weekly. Tyres are inspected at every 12-month / 15,000 km service; wheel alignment is checked every 24 months / 30,000 km.

wheelRL.name: Rear wheel and tyre, left
wheelRL.desc: Pre-start: tyre pressure, cuts and tread; check pressures weekly. Tyres are inspected at every 12-month / 15,000 km service; wheel alignment is checked every 24 months / 30,000 km. Drum brakes are checked every 24 months.

wheelRR.name: Rear wheel and tyre, right
wheelRR.desc: Pre-start: tyre pressure, cuts and tread; check pressures weekly. Tyres are inspected at every 12-month / 15,000 km service; wheel alignment is checked every 24 months / 30,000 km. Drum brakes are checked every 24 months.

grille.name: Grille
grille.desc: Inspected with the body at each service.

headlight.name: Headlight and indicator (left)
headlight.desc: Pre-start: lights and indicators working. Lights are checked at every service.

foglight.name: Fog light (left)
foglight.desc: Lights are checked at every service.

engine.name: Engine: 2.4 L turbo diesel
engine.desc: MR (23MY): 4N15. MV (24MY): 4N16 with AdBlue/SCR. Quick check: a blue AdBlue filler cap means MV. Change the engine oil and filter every 12 months / 15,000 km (severe use: every 7,500 km; dust, rough tracks, idling and short trips on the course arguably count as severe, so ask the dealer). Oil grade and capacity were not looked up: the dealer supplies them. Every service: diesel small-quantity injection learning and the service reminder reset. MR: audible valve clearance check each service, full check every 48 months.

oilfilter.name: Engine oil filter
oilfilter.desc: Replaced at every service (12 months / 15,000 km, or 7,500 km in severe use). Part number not looked up: the dealer supplies it under capped-price servicing.

fuel.name: Fuel filter and lines
fuel.desc: MV: replace the fuel filter at every service. MR: every 24 months / 30,000 km. Fuel lines are checked every 24 months. Part number not looked up.

aircleaner.name: Air cleaner
aircleaner.desc: Inspected at every service; element replaced every 36 months / 45,000 km (MR and MV). In dusty course work ask the dealer about the severe-use interval.

adblue.name: AdBlue system (MV only)
adblue.desc: MV only (4N16 with SCR): check the AdBlue level at pre-start and at each service. A blue AdBlue filler cap means the ute is an MV.

cooling.name: Radiator and coolant
cooling.desc: Mitsubishi Genuine Super Long Life Coolant Premium, 50 % with demineralised or distilled water (capacity not looked up). MV: replace at 96 months / 120,000 km, then 156 months / 195,000 km. MR: first at 8 years / 165,000 km, then every 5 years / 105,000 km. Check the level weekly.

brakes.name: Brakes and brake fluid
brakes.desc: Brakes, pedals and park brake are inspected at every service. Change the brake fluid every 24 months / 30,000 km. Brake hoses and drum brakes are checked every 24 months.

driveline.name: Transmission, transfer and differentials
driveline.desc: Front and rear diff oil (normal use): 60 months / 75,000 km, again at 120 months / 150,000 km. Transfer oil: 72 months / 90,000 km, again at 144 months. Severe use: change transfer and diff oils every 24 months / 30,000 km; MV automatic transmission fluid at 72 months. Leaks are checked at every service.

service.name: Dealer servicing, capped price and warranty
service.desc: Service by date: 12 months / 15,000 km, whichever comes first. Capped price and the extended warranty need servicing at an authorised Mitsubishi dealer within 2 months / 2,000 km of each due point; a missed service lapses the program and voids the extended warranty. Capped prices incl. labour: 23MY $449 / $549 / $549 / $799 / $549 / $799 / $549 / $999 / $699 / $799 (services 1-10); 24MY bought on or before 30 Nov 2025: $489 x 5, then $799 / $749 / $949 / $849 / $899. taskTracker has no ute template: set up a 12-month recurring dealer service job by date (km readings on taskTracker are odometer km, not hours). Keep the dealer stamp in the service book.
